profile.name: Dhol Cholom
profile.tagline: A traditional Manipuri dance showcased at the Eikhoigi Imphal International Film Festival.
profile.insight: Dhol Cholom was performed as part of the "Eikhoigi Legacy" cultural showcase at the 2nd Eikhoigi Imphal International Film Festival in Imphal, Manipur, on 7 February 2025.
profile.profile: Dhol Cholom is a traditional dance from Manipur, India. It was featured in the cultural programming of the 2nd Eikhoigi Imphal International Film Festival held in Imphal in February 2025. The dance was presented alongside other traditional forms such as Thang-Ta and Thang Leiteng.
profile.profile_long: Dhol Cholom is a traditional dance form originating from the region of Manipur, India. In the context of contemporary cultural events, it has been recognized as a significant element of the region's traditional performance arts. On 7 February 2025, the dance was featured as part of the "Eikhoigi Legacy" cultural showcase during the 2nd Eikhoigi Imphal International Film Festival, which took place in Imphal, Manipur. The performance was presented alongside other traditional practices, including Thang-Ta and Thang Leiteng. Beyond its inclusion in this specific festival program, detailed information regarding the history, technique, musical structure, or cultural significance of Dhol Cholom is not described in sources.
